chunks: Do not say, regarding what your tongues describe as lies, 'This is lawful and this is forbidden,' to impute lies to God. Indeed, those who impute lies to God will not succeed.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to impute lies to God by declaring things halal or haram?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *tawqif* (divine specification) in jurisprudence, warning against the arbitrary imposition of personal opinion (*ra'y*) as divine law. It highlights the gravity of *iftira'* (fabrication), noting that while all prophets are protected from error, jurists who claim infallibility in deriving rulings risk attributing falsehood to God. This serves as a foundational critique of unchecked legal innovation and a reminder that true success lies in adhering to authentic revelation and the Ahl al-Bayt's interpretation.
